outcome: Have a safe, functioning loading bay available by 16:00 on 3 November 2026.
text: Fictional exercise only, as of 08:00 on 3 November 2026. Aster depot's main loading bay is closed after a door sensor failed. Supervisor Nia can authorise repair, but has not yet done so. A replacement sensor may arrive at 11:00; delivery is unconfirmed. Technician Mika is available, but electrical isolation has not been certified. Independent inspector Sol requires both isolation documentation and a successful door test before signing off. Repair completion alone does not authorise reopening. The backup loading bay is an alternative only if the landlord consents and dispatch confirms a rerouting plan; neither has happened. Human authorisation and safety sign-off are required before either bay opens. No approval, delivery confirmation or inspection evidence is supplied.
